title: A Striped Sail
offer: Your boat has a dragon head, but no sail. I will weave you a little one, with red and white stripes. Bring me six crates of wool, and give me two nights.

steps.say: Now the looms clatter. Come back in two days!
Red and white stripes, like the great ships! It is small, but on a windy day it helps your arms.

fact: A big viking sail took a weaver years; it was worth as much as the ship.
